name: gedankenexperiment
description: Source-grounded scenario simulation and failure-mode synthesis. Mentally simulate workflows through the local code (the source of truth), build a failure-mode bank across normal/edge/adversarial/race/timeout/retry/partial-failure cases, cluster failures by shared root cause and missing invariant, then design durable invariant-level fixes — not per-transcript band-aids. Use to harden call/chat/order/scheduling/payment/onboarding flows, audit state transitions, find edge cases, or trace runtime behavior before implementing.
